answer: Collateral ladder with a cooling vault: each identity deposits 70 POA into a vault for 16 epochs, and a funder's n-th identity pays 70 times 1.3 to the power n-1, so the tenth costs about 740. A gale of simultaneous signups from one funder doubles that fee for an epoch. Auditors replay deposits on-chain, and a comet of fakes proven linked loses 60% of its vault.
